Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a small puppy named Max who was very loyal. They loved to play together every day. One day, Lily and Max went for a walk in the park. 

As they walked, Lily saw a big tree and ran to it. Max said, "I want to climb that tree!" But Lily was stubborn and said, "No, Max! That tree is too big for us!" 

Max tried to climb the tree, but he was too tall and heavy. Lily started to cry and Max tried to get up the tree.
